series_annotator.narrative: The series exhibits mixed trend direction and weak seasonality, with high noise and unpredictable behavior (spectral entropy > 0.85). Due to high model consensus but unstable rankings, a robust baseline approach (e.g., median) is recommended to avoid overfitting to noisy patterns.

reasoning.robust_median: series_profile.noise.unpredictable=true AND spectral_entropy=0.887 → robust_median is recommended for high-noise, near-white-noise series (Goerg 2013)
reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.model_landscape.rankings_stable=false (kendall_tau=0.3099) → inverse_rmse_weights with shrinkage=0.35 is recommended for unstable rankings (Genre et al. 2013)
reasoning.best_per_horizon_by_validation: series_profile.model_landscape.horizon_homogeneous=false → per-horizon selection is appropriate when different models dominate at different horizons (Timmermann 2006)

excluded_highlights.stl_hierarchical_stacking_p2_sh0.0: series_profile.combination_recommendation.avoid contains 'stl_hierarchical_stacking' due to high noise and unpredictable behavior
